product.name: GripForce™ Mecanum Wheel Roller Pack (40A Durometer, 4 Rollers)

warnings: No dimensions are stated, so every size is an estimate. The roller length (~50 mm) and maximum diameter (~24 mm) are scaled to fit a 104 mm diameter mecanum wheel with about 10 rollers around its rim. The ~8 mm bore is assumed to hold a small bearing (outer diameter about 8 mm). The pin is assumed to be about 4 mm in diameter and slightly longer than the roller, but the pin and hardware sizes are not reflected in the bounding box. The roller is modeled as a symmetric barrel centered on the origin with its axis along Z. The studded tread dimples are not modeled. The full pack laid out on a table would be larger than the single-roller bounds.
No dimensions are given; all sizes are estimates taken from the supplied boundsMm.
Only the largest item (one roller) is modeled; the pins, bearings, shims, and e-clips are omitted.
The studded tread bumps are decorative and omitted.
The barrel end diameter (20 mm) and the arc profile are visual estimates.
Any bearing counterbore at the roller ends is omitted because it is uncertain.
